story.title: Zach's Journey
story.blurb: From a mansion where his father despises his eyes to the deck of a pirate ship, Zach's life told in memories at ages five, ten, seventeen and beyond.

lines.text: Zach is 5

segments.text: Zach is 5

lines.text: Zach is looking in the mirror in his luxurious room within the Mansion. He can see the Big Dipper today! His mom says that his eyes are what makes him special… his dad however, doesn’t really like his eyes, so Zach doesn’t maintain eye contact with him. Oh right… might as well introduce Zach and family.

Zacharias Smith, the only child of his mother Maria and his father John Smith. The family are well-known people with them being among the higher class and John having political ties. They are respected… at least Maria and John are… not many people know of Zach’s existence, due to Zach being a young child and his dad not really wanting people to see him. Due to this, Zach never really went outside, so most of his knowledge came from books and the occasional newscast. He loves his mom and his dad, even though his dad doesn’t really show Zach any recognition, always muttering something along the lines of “damn brat”, “eyes of a freak”, or the most common one, “no time for this”. Zach doesn’t understand why his dad is always cold to him but he tries his best to be the “best son”.

lines.text: Zach is tired, just tired. For 10 years, for 10 years he’s had to deal with John, and he’s sick of it. So, with a packed bag, a new outfit, and the mindset of “I need out” Zach made his way to the door of his- no- John’s house. But not before stopping in the living room and seeing the family heirloom hanging above the mantle of the fireplace. The Smith family sword Oblivion… Zach knows John isn’t going to miss it, so Zach takes it. After all, it’s a big bad world out there, having a weapon isn’t a bad idea. And with Oblivion strapped to his back, Zach sneaks his way outside.
